about: Speaking in five (22 Nov 2026): the Writing 'in five' ladder for a Speaking Part. Five moves, one sentence each, the school's frames first (data/drills/speaking/*.json). {X} = what the pupil picks or types. 'q' on a subject is the examiner's question ({X} filled). 'secs' is the target length of the whole answer said aloud.
name: Part 1
how: A Part 1 answer in five: buy a second, answer, give a reason, add an example from your life, then the other side. About twenty seconds, about you.

nameAsk.title: What's your answer?
nameAsk.aim: Pick the one that's true for you. Your five will be about it.

subjects.label: Free time
subjects.q: What do you enjoy doing in your free time?

subjects.label: School
subjects.q: What's your favourite subject at school?

subjects.label: The future
subjects.q: Where would you like to live in the future?

slots.label: Buy time
slots.job: buy a second to think, without going silent
slots.q: Which one gives you a second to think?

ways.t: Hmm, let me think about that for a second.

slots.label: Answer
slots.q: Which one answers the question straight away?

ways.t: Well, I'd say it has to be {X}.
To be honest, I'd have to say {X}.
What I really love is that …

slots.label: Example
slots.job: add an example from your own life
slots.q: Which one adds an example from your life?

ways.t: Just to give you an example, …

slots.label: The other side
slots.job: add the other side, so the answer doesn't stop too soon
slots.q: Which one adds the other side?

ways.t: Having said that, I have to admit that …
